posts.t:
The Devils have allowed the 3rd-fewest expected goals per game, but rank 24th in team save %. 

Nico Daws has saved 2.9 goals below expected (55th in NHL). Jake Allen has saved 3.5 below expected (59th).

And yet NJD have 12 pts in 10 games. 

Hellebuyck could make them a wagon.

videos.t: Bratt, Daws, Gritsyuk, Pesce, Keefe talk about the Devils' 4-1 win against Anaheim
